name: Wicker Snare
desc: Woven by hand. Slightly itchy, entirely legal.

name: Iron Snare
desc: Forged in Sheffield, so it's going to hold.

name: Night Snare
desc: Works best after dark, like most good ideas and bad decisions.

name: Water Snare
desc: Waterproof, naturally. Brook and Tide creatures hate to see it coming.

name: Silver Snare
desc: Hallmarked, polished and ridiculously expensive. It will hold, and it will look good doing it.
